Legal / Privacy

Privacy, in plain language.

This page describes the general approach for this public website. Product-specific privacy terms may apply when you use MoCHi or future Toumiō products.

Last updated: August 2026

What this website collects

This public website is designed to be readable without an account. It does not ask you to submit personal information to browse its pages. Cloudflare Pages or other hosting infrastructure may process standard technical request information such as an IP address, browser details and the requested URL to deliver and secure the site.

Links to other products

Links to MoCHi and other services take you to separate products or websites. Their collection and use of information are governed by the policies presented by those services.

Cookies and analytics

This initial public site does not intentionally set advertising cookies or embed third-party analytics. If that changes, this page should be updated before those tools are enabled.

Contact and updates

As Toumiō Labs adds products, this policy will be updated to explain material changes. This page is a starting point for the public website and should be supplemented with a reviewed contact method and product-specific notices before broader collection of personal information.
